meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, clean, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把动画帧脚本渲染成成片视频,并发布到云端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把动画或视频素材批量渲染成片并发布到云端
copy.tagline_en: Render animation frames into finished videos and publish them to the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render animated compositions into finished videos and ship them at scale

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令走开发流程：初始化项目、搜目录并安装现成动画片段、写合成、跑 lint 和 check 检查、开预览、按画质档渲染视频，并诊断构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求做视频合成、动效或渲染，或提到 init、catalog、render 等命令，或需要排查构建、渲染失败时接管。

say.text: 用 hyperframes 初始化一个新项目
搜一下目录里有没有逐行显示标题的动画
检查一下当前合成有没有问题
say.note: 会跑 lint 和 check 并列出问题

howto.what_en: Claude drives the HyperFrames CLI: scaffolds a project, searches and adds catalog moves, authors compositions, runs lint and check, opens a preview, renders video at draft/looks/delivery quality, and diagnoses build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for video compositions, motion, or renders, mention commands like init, catalog, or render, or need build or render failures diagnosed.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a headline reveal
